desc.zh: 用原数组的位置记录正数是否出现，逐次交换并解释重复值为何必须停止。
desc.en: Record positive values in their own array positions, tracing swaps and why equal destinations stop.

concepts.name: Presence by placement
concepts.description: Derive x minus one as the destination and bound useful swaps by permanently filled slots.

concepts.name: Reversible placement trace
concepts.description: Follow chained swaps and duplicate stops with explicit operation markers.
